e2e_rows.question: How do I replace the mechanical seal on the HX-200?
e2e_rows.answer:
Safety: WARNING: Seal faces are brittle. Never touch the lapped faces with bare hands and never drop the seal. [1]
Safety: WARNING: Lock out and tag out the electrical supply before any maintenance work. Stored energy in the coupling and residual pressure in the casing can cause serious injury. [2]
Procedure from HX-200 Centrifugal Process Pump Service Manual, section 6.1 Mechanical seal replacement:
Replace the mechanical seal when leakage exceeds 10 drops per minute or when alarm E-52 is shown. [3]
1. Lock out and tag out the power supply and close the suction and discharge valves. [3]
2. Drain the casing through the drain plug and allow the pump to cool below 40 °C. [3]
3. Remove the coupling guard and the spacer coupling. [3]
4. Remove the gland bolts and slide the old mechanical seal off the shaft. [3]
5. Clean the shaft sleeve and inspect it for scoring deeper than 0.1 mm. [3]
6. Fit the new mechanical seal MS-4 using the supplied assembly lubricant. [3]
7. Tighten the gland bolts evenly to the torque listed in Table 2. [3]
8. Refit the coupling guard, open the valves, vent the casing and run a leak test for 10 minutes. [3]
Referenced value (HX-200 fastener tightening torques): Gland bolt: Fastener M10; Torque 25 Nm [4]

e2e_rows.question: What are the steps for changing the compressor oil on the HX-500?
e2e_rows.answer:
Safety: WARNING: Hot oil can cause severe burns. Wear heat-resistant gloves and never open the drain plug while the system is pressurised. [1]
Safety: WARNING: Lock out and tag out the electrical supply before any maintenance work. [2]
Procedure from HX-500 Rotary Screw Compressor Service Manual, section 6.1 Oil change:
Change the oil every 4000 hours or once a year, whichever comes first. Use Helix CompOil 46 only. [3]
1. Run the compressor until it reaches operating temperature, then stop it and lock out the power supply. [3]
2. Fully depressurise the system and wait 10 minutes. [3]
3. Place a container of at least 40 L under the drain and remove the oil drain plug. [3]
4. Allow the oil to drain completely and replace the oil filter (see Table 3). [3]
5. Refit the oil drain plug and tighten it to the torque listed in Table 2. [3]
6. Fill with new oil through the filler plug until the level reaches the mark on the sight glass (capacity in Table 1). [3]
7. Run the compressor for 5 minutes and re-check the oil level. [3]
Referenced value (HX-500 maintenance schedule): Replace oil: Interval 4000 h; Performed by Technician [4]
Referenced value (HX-500 fastener tightening torques): Oil drain plug: Fastener G3/4; Torque 50 Nm [5]

e2e_rows.question: How do I replace the impeller on the HX-200?
e2e_rows.answer:
Safety: WARNING: Lock out and tag out the electrical supply before any maintenance work. Stored energy in the coupling and residual pressure in the casing can cause serious injury. [1]
Procedure from HX-200 Centrifugal Process Pump Service Manual, section 6.2 Impeller replacement:
1. Perform steps 1 to 4 of Section 6.1 to isolate and open the pump. [2]
2. Remove the casing bolts and withdraw the back pull-out assembly. [2]
3. Remove the impeller bolt and pull the impeller from the shaft with puller tool PT-200. [2]
4. Inspect the impeller for erosion and replace it if the vane thickness is below 3 mm. [2]
5. Fit the new impeller and tighten the impeller bolt to the torque listed in Table 2. [2]
6. Refit the assembly and tighten the casing bolts to the torque listed in Table 2 in a cross pattern. [2]

e2e_rows.question: How do I start the HX-200 for the first time?
e2e_rows.answer:
Safety: WARNING: Lock out and tag out the electrical supply before any maintenance work. Stored energy in the coupling and residual pressure in the casing can cause serious injury. [1]
Procedure from HX-200 Centrifugal Process Pump Service Manual, section 3.2 First start-up:
1. Check that the direction of rotation matches the arrow on the casing. [2]
2. Fill the casing completely with the process fluid to prime the pump and vent the air. [2]
3. Open the suction valve fully. [2]
4. Start the motor with the discharge valve closed, then open the discharge valve slowly until the duty point is reached. [2]
5. Check the mechanical seal for leakage and the bearings for abnormal temperature during the first hour. [2]
Figure 1 shows the main components referenced in this manual. [2]

e2e_rows.question: How do I replace the return filter on the HX-900?
e2e_rows.answer:
Safety: WARNING: Lock out and tag out the electrical supply before any maintenance work. [1]
Procedure from HX-900 Hydraulic Power Unit Service Manual, section 6.1 Return filter element replacement:
Replace the return filter element every 1000 hours or when alarm E-47 is shown. [2]
1. Stop the unit, lock out the power supply and release all system pressure. [2]
2. Place a drip tray under the filter housing and remove the housing. [2]
3. Remove the old element and inspect it for metal particles. [2]
4. Fit a new element with a new O-ring lubricated with clean oil. [2]
5. Tighten the filter housing to the torque listed in Table 2. [2]
6. Bleed the circuit as described in Section 3.2 and check for leaks. [2]
Referenced value (HX-900 fastener tightening torques): Filter housing: Fastener M12; Torque 70 Nm [3]

e2e_rows.question: At what suction pressure should the HX-200 be stopped?
e2e_rows.answer:
According to Helix Dynamics - HX-200 Quick Field Card: STOP the pump if suction pressure drops below 0.5 bar (alarm E-47 [1].
According to HX-200 Centrifugal Process Pump Service Manual: Table 4 (HX-200 alarm codes), row: E-47: Description Low suction pressure; Probable cause Closed suction valve, clogged strainer or air ingress; Remedy Open the suction valve fully, clean the strainer and check the suction line for air leaks [2].

e2e_rows.question: What does this alarm mean and what should I do?
e2e_rows.answer: HX-200: alarm E-47 means low suction pressure. Probable cause: Closed suction valve, clogged strainer or air ingress. Remedy: Open the suction valve fully, clean the strainer and check the suction line for air leaks. [1]

e2e_rows.question: What should I do about this alarm?
e2e_rows.answer: HX-500: alarm E-47 means separator differential pressure high. Probable cause: Clogged oil separator element. Remedy: Replace the oil separator element (see Table 3). [1]

e2e_rows.question: What oil capacity does this machine have?
e2e_rows.answer:
HX-500: alarm E-71 means oil level low. Probable cause: Oil leak or insufficient fill. Remedy: Inspect the unit for leaks and refill the oil to the sight-glass mark (capacity in Table 1). [1]
Safety: WARNING: Hot oil can cause severe burns. Wear heat-resistant gloves and never open the drain plug while the system is pressurised. [2]
